meta_title: L Grayson Auto Electrics | Car Electrical Repair Sheffield
meta_description: L Grayson Auto Electrics in Sheffield specialises in car electrical repairs, diagnostics and battery services. Fast, reliable auto electrical work. Call now.
hero_subhead: Car won't start or lights playing up? We diagnose and fix electrical faults fast, keeping you on the road.
services_heading: Complete Auto Electrical Services in Sheffield
services_subhead: From battery replacement to complex wiring diagnostics, we fix what's wrong and get you moving again.

services.title: Battery Replacement & Testing
services.desc: Failed battery? We test, replace and dispose of old units responsibly. Most jobs completed while you wait at our Halfway workshop.

services.title: Starter Motor & Alternator Repair
services.desc: Car won't turn over or battery won't charge? We diagnose and replace starter motors and alternators with quality parts and full warranty.

services.title: Electrical Fault Diagnostics
services.desc: Mysterious warning lights or intermittent electrical gremlins? We use modern diagnostic equipment to pinpoint the fault accurately.

services.title: Wiring & Cable Repairs
services.desc: Corroded or damaged wiring causing electrical problems? We repair or replace loom sections and connections to restore full function.

services.title: Lighting System Repairs
services.desc: Headlights, brake lights or interior electrics not working? We repair or replace bulbs, switches, relays and wiring harnesses.

services.title: Central Locking & Window Motor Repair
services.desc: Electric windows stuck or locks not responding? We repair or replace actuators, motors and electrical switches.

about_pullquote: I got into this to help folks avoid being ripped off by hidden electrical gremlins.
about_para_1: L Grayson Auto Electrics has been diagnosing and fixing car electrical problems across Sheffield for nearly two decades. We operate from a well-equipped workshop at White Rook Business Park in Halfway, where our experience spans everything from simple battery swaps to complex wiring faults on modern vehicles.
about_para_2: We've built our reputation on honest diagnostics and fair pricing — no guesswork, no unnecessary parts swaps. Customers keep coming back because we get to the root cause, explain what's wrong in plain English, and fix it right the first time. We're not a franchise or a quick-fit chain; we're a proper local electrical specialist.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Motorists Say About Us

reviews.text: Car wouldn't start on a freezing morning — thought I was done for. L Grayson tested the battery, found it was kaput, and had a new one fitted within an hour. Fair price too. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had electrical gremlins with my dashboard lights. Took it to another garage first and they quoted me £800 to replace the whole loom. L Grayson diagnosed a dodgy relay for £60. Much happier. Very knowledgeable bloke.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Starter motor failed mid-week. Called in the morning, they fitted a replacement the same afternoon. Professional work, warranty on the part, and no messing about. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: James P.
